title: Almond Coconut Protein Bars
description: Chewy no-bake bars loaded with almonds, shredded coconut and protein powder.
steps: Mix the almond butter, coconut oil and honey until combined.
Stir in the protein powder, coconut and salt.
Press into a lined pan, chill 2 hours, then cut into bars.

source.label: Adapted from Minimalist Baker no-bake bars

notes: The fiber in almonds and coconut slows digestion, which is exactly what you want from a between-meals snack.
